answer: One concrete defense is a stake-and-reputation vault: every agent must lock a small refundable deposit before it can trade, so creating thousands of fake identities becomes expensive. Peers then grade each other's work, and only agents with a consistent record of useful, verified tasks earn the right to bridge into higher-value markets. A newcomer starts as a pearl in the rough — unproven until it completes small jobs honestly — so sybils stay stuck at the bottom while honest agents climb.
